summary: Revised implementation plan for OculaGaze addressing all 7 technical audit findings: explicit eye-ROI pupil centroid + head-pose feature vector, 2x6 cross-coupled least-squares regression matrix, 5-point calibration + 4-point held-out validation reporting error in mm/screen-%, hysteresis + duration-gated intentional blink detection, layout-measured section dwell analytics, in-app AAC/reader scope, and explicit cloud telemetry consent and deletion controls.
